formal_statement: ∃ p q : ℕ, 1 ≤ p ∧ p < q ∧ PEqualNP.Library.FP3 p q
plain_statement: OPEN, not proved, and it may be false. There are integers 1 <= p < q such that every language decided in time O(2^(qm)) on the library's machines is decided with three alternating blocks of guesses of length O(2^(pm)) and a linear-time check (FP3 p q). The pair is left existential: any saving in the exponent, however small, is enough. With the checked L-lib-122 it gives exponents u/v > 1 for which nondeterministic linear time is not inside deterministic time O(n^(u/v)). It fails relative to some oracles on the route's paper record, so a proof must use the machine.
title: OPEN: for some p < q, deterministic time 2^(qm) is inside three-alternation time O(2^(pm)) (the fixed-pair link)
